title: eludite.editor.complete output
description: The completion list as the editor shows it. Called from the UI thread (keys, typing) this is the state right after the request was sent, usually `loading`; called from another thread (an agent) the call waits up to 5 s for the list.

state.description: `loading`: waiting for the language server (or the syntax tree); `open`: the list is shown; `closed`: nothing to show (no items, or nothing matches the typed text).

source.description: Where the shown items come from: the language server, or the identifiers of the document's syntax tree (the fallback while the server is starting or the solution is loading).

filter.description: The text typed since the start of the word, which filters the list (fuzzy).

items.description: The first 100 matching items in display order.

kind.description: LSP CompletionItemKind name in snake case (`method`, `property`, `class`, ...); `text` for syntax-tree identifiers.
